name: Francisco Assis - § 28 - Am 4
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: B. whereas under Article 309 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, the EIB, entirely owned by the Member States, is tasked with contributing to the achievement of the EU’s objectives, including to the balanced and steady development of the internal market in the interests of the Union; whereas the EIB has branded itself the EU’s climate bank, in view of the additional investments needed to deliver the green transition; whereas the EIB Group consists of the EIB and the European Investment Fund (EIF);
